_comment: Presets for the Position Selector's one-click scenario generator
(pages/position_selector/autogen.py, tab 'Auto scenario'). One preset
is everything a dynamic scenario needs: where towers may stand, how the
walk moves, how it is checked, Eve, the parked row and the traffic.
Override the file with STREAMFLEX_SCENARIO_PRESETS.
variants / seed -- how many distinct tower sets (each with its walk)
to offer, ranked by the channel traced along the walk itself.
walk_space -- the Path Generator's walkable grid: street_detection
'raycast' | 'bbox', cell_m, clearance_m, height_thresh_m,
osm_walk_mode 'detected' | 'roads' | 'both', confine_city.
radio -- planning maps: a radio map (map_*) for coverage with
min_signal_db / gap_fill_m / signal_bridge_m as the walker's limits,
and ray-count probes every probe_spacing_m (probe_*), counting rays
within count_within_db of the strongest. Probes are always traced
with diffraction so its share is known (diffracted rays only show
up from ~1e7 samples). Towers are planned on plan_cell_m blocks.
towers -- candidate mounts on pool_buildings buildings at least
min_building_height_m tall: kinds 'center' / 'corners' (rooftop mast
tx_elevation_m above the roof) and 'facade' (corner mounts below the
roofline at facade_fractions of the building height, facade_offset_m
off the wall, never below facade_min_height_m); per_building = how
many of each kind a building contributes. n_towers, min_spacing_m,
min_handover_m2, min_rays / target_rays as in the tower planner.
objective 'walk': a set is worth the sum of its walk_area_factor x
(walk length / plan_cell_m) best cells -- what a walk of that length
can actually use; 'area': the sum over everything it covers (picks
tall roofs with wide, thin coverage and never a facade mount).
diffraction -- avoid: count only strong rays without diffraction in
their chain and drop cells where diffraction carries more than
max_share of the power (towers, walk pull); planning scales cells by
(1 - share)^plan_penalty, the ranking of the traced walks by
(1 - share)^penalty. The planning probes see too few diffracted rays
for the share to be a trustworthy factor, hence plan_penalty 0.
walk -- the multi-tower walk (the Path Generator's fields);
leg_points 'auto' or [min, max] points per tower; walk_tries walks
per tower set, traced, the best-ranked kept.
validation -- the walk sampled every spacing_m and traced against its
serving tower; score = mean of min(rays / target_rays, 1), times
(1 - share)^penalty when diffraction is avoided; variants are ranked
by score x (1 - revisit_slope x (revisit - revisit_free)), since a walk
shuttling along the few rich streets samples the same channel twice.
eve -- the Eve tab's fields. parked -- presets + seed (the CIR
Generator's defaults for the rest). traffic -- options as in a
traffic file; dt/n_steps always come from the walk. per_variant:
false = traffic only for the variant you keep (it is the slow part).
crowd -- walking people on the pavements (traffic.crowd): people per km
of pavement, walking speed, standing share, pavements along roads
(auto/yes/no), avoid_cars = wait for cars at crossings. Saved as
<name>_people.json next to the traffic; built with it, for the kept
variant.

realistic_long.label: Realistic long walk (kazan, 5 min, 4 towers)
realistic_long.description: The parameters of positions_kazan_center_long: 60 000 points at 5 ms, Brownian 10-15 m/s, 4 towers, Eve 5 m parallel left with 2 m drifting error, sparse parked row, 1000 moving cars. Towers may also go on facade corners; diffraction is not avoided.

realistic_long_low_diffraction.label: Realistic long walk, little diffraction
realistic_long_low_diffraction.description: As realistic_long, but towers, walk and ranking prefer links whose power does not come by diffraction: only strong rays without diffraction count, every street is weighed by (1 - share)^2 and streets where diffraction carries over half the power count for nothing. Probes are traced with 5e6 samples, since diffracted rays only show up with many.
